text:
nina: canary in eu-central failed during post-upgrade hook, mount error for payments/stripe-credentials :frowning:
deploy-bot: canary failure detected for payments-service chart v2.5.0 -> post-upgrade hook: secret-mount error
tom: ugh, looks like regional secret sync skipped eu-central again. preflight didn't catch because it only checks chart schema not secret presence.
yoel: do we have a rapid path? options:
- rollback eu-central to v2.4.1 (safe, but migration in 2.5.0 makes rollback risky)
- create secret in-cluster from vault and re-run canary (fast if creds available)
- hotpatch values with literal apiKey for eu-central, then promote (ugly)
ops: product asked to avoid rollback if at all possible (migrations included).
release-manager: holding promotions to eu-* and ap-* until we confirm. applying manual hold.
ops: I can pull the cred from vault and create the secret. which do we prefer?
nina: prefer secret creation + recheck. keep edgezone pinned to v2.4.* until we have an automation. we don't want half the tenants on different minor versions.
tom: agree. also add a short-term preflight that verifies k8s secret existence if values reference secretRef. I'll open GH issue.
ops: running one-off to create secret and restart pods. command:
```
VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal vault kv get -field=apiKey secret/payments/eu | \
  kubectl -n payments create secret generic stripe-credentials --from-literal=apiKey=$(cat -) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n payments rollout restart deploy/payments-service
```
ops: secret created, pods restarting. logs show mounts ok.
deploy-bot: promotion paused by release-manager at 1749900025
ops: canary probes running. hopeful.
deploy-bot: canary health checks passed for eu-central, payments-service v2.5.0 :white_check_mark:
release-manager: OK to resume promotions, but enforce 15m stagger between regions and pin edgezone pipeline to v2.5.0 for next 24h to avoid mix. adding note to release notes: "eu-central manual secret sync performed during rollout".
yoel: filing follow-ups: GH #4610 -> preflight secret-exists check; GH #4611 -> console alert if secretRef unresolved; GH #4612 -> pin/unpin automation for edgezone pipeline.
tom: small ops note for oncall: if next canary fails with secret mount, prefer manual secret sync and recheck unless DB/index migrations show failures. do NOT roll back unless necessary.
ops: going to add a one-liner to the rollout checklist: "If values reference secretRef: verify secret exists in target cluster (vault sync) before promotion."
nina: also add a release-note entry under Known Issues and Remediation. I'll draft the blurb.
release-manager: blurb: "During v2.5.0 promotion, eu-central required a manual secret-sync for payments stripe credentials. If you see post-upgrade secret mount errors, create the secret from vault and re-run canary. A preflight check will be added to prevent this in future."
yoel: thanks. I'll keep the hold in place until the automation PR is merged, but unblocking current promotions.
release-manager: hold removed at 1749900750. closing thread and tracking action items. :white_check_mark:
